text:
maya: incident-bot page — P0 latency spike on runtime after canary rollout. noticed at ~15:12 UTC.
incident-bot: INCIDENT OPENED (P0) — runtime.latency.p95 > 2.5s across canary pool. Auto-notify to #incidents and on-call.
sean: I'm on it, grabbing logs from the canary hosts. initial hypothesis: kernel selection fallback to generic kernels after new kernel config shipped.
ryan_sre: Confirmed elevated tail latencies on hosts r-infer-08..11. Kernel fallback entries in /var/log/runtime.log show repeated "no optimized kernel found" for attention op.
maya: how many customer requests affected? any enterprise hits?
julia_support: Support: two paying customers (AcmePager, Finly) reported slowness on their apps — tickets 4521, 4523. They're seeing timeouts ~10s.
ana_pm: (ana_pm) pushing for immediate traffic shift off canaries to avoid more customer impact. recommended 100% abort on canary slice.
sean: agree. prepping command to move traffic slice. will also toggle quantized-runpath fallback to off for canary.
deploy-bot: deploy notice: rollout "runtime-optim-2026-03" started 2026-03-15T15:05:22Z, canary=10%.
sean: running rollback for canary slice now: `redwood rollout traffic set --deployment runtime-optim-2026-03 --slice canary --pct 0`
sean: done. traffic shifted from canary -> stable at 15:20 UTC. monitoring metrics.
ryan_sre: p95 dropped from ~2.6s -> 0.38s on stable within 30s of shift. KV cache hit rate unchanged. Looks like the canary binaries triggered kernel selection path that missed asm kernels.
maya: good. keep incident open until root cause identified and prod fully stable. escalate to eng-runtime.
sean: grabbed core dump and runtime logs. snippet: ```
[15:13:07] kernel_selector.cc: WARN no optimized kernel for attention_fwd(seq=2048, quantized=false)
[15:13:07] batcher.cpp: WARN forced to continuous-batch=1 due to kernel mismatch
```
ryan_sre: noticed also a config delta in canary image: KERNEL_PRIORITY_ORDER env had stale value "generic,asm32,asm16" instead of "asm16,asm32,generic". that would cause fallback to generic.
julia_support: AcmePager ticket updated: they say latency normalized after ~15:24 UTC. Thanks team.
nana_pm: (ana_pm) customer outreach plan: send a brief incident note to the two customers, CC account owners. Julia, can you draft? Mark severity as "major" and include mitigation steps.
julia_support: will draft and share in #customer-comms.
sean: creating a canary blocked tag on pipeline to prevent re-rollout until patch is validated. also adding a preflight check to assert KERNEL_PRIORITY_ORDER ordering before image promote.
ryan_sre: repro steps for eng-runtime: pull canary image `redwood/image:runtime-optim-2026-03-canary`, run unit kernel discovery: `./bin/kernel_probe --list | grep attention` — confirm missing asm16 kernel.
sean: temporary hotfix branch: set env KERNEL_PRIORITY_ORDER=asm16,asm32,generic and re-run smoke tests. If green, will create a patched rollout with new canary=false vetting.
maya: do we need kill-switch? the traffic shift worked, but if rollout resumes accidentally, we should have a feature flag to block kernel-selection-opt.
ryan_sre: added kill-switch flag `runtime.enable_kernel_affinity_v2=false` in feature-flags for all environments. deploy-bot confirms feature flag updated at 15:35 UTC.
deploy-bot: FEATURE FLAG UPDATE: runtime.enable_kernel_affinity_v2 set to false for org=* at 2026-03-15T15:35:12Z.
sean: will coordinate with eng-runtime to put a guarded rollout with canary=1% and manual verification of kernel probe.
nana_pm: (ana_pm) can we estimate customer impact window and notify SRE/OPS leads?
ryan_sre: impacted window ~15:12 -> 15:24 UTC. approx 12 minutes. affected request volume ~0.8% of overall traffic but hit critical enterprise SLAs for those customers. recommend postmortem with RCA and checklist item to validate env var ordering as part of release gating.
maya: thanks. I'm handing off to eng-runtime on-call for RCA and postmortem. Closing immediate mitigation — keep thread open for follow-ups.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED — mitigation: traffic rebalanced and feature flag applied. severity remains P0 pending RCA.
sean: attaching logs and the config diff to the ticket. will follow up with a small postmortem doc and action items.
julia_support: customers notified. tickets updated.
ryan_sre: closing monitoring loop: setting alert threshold to p95>1.0s for next 24h with noisy suppression off.
maya: thanks everyone. good coordination. we'll reconvene if any regression appears.
